title: How far does quantisation take a local security tutor in Greek and in English, a benchmark of small open models on cybersecurity questions
description: Code and aggregated results of the study "How far does quantisation take a local security tutor in Greek and in English, a benchmark of small open models on cybersecurity questions", a follow on study of the SentinelSphere platform carried out under the Horizon Europe project ResilMesh, Grant Agreement No. 101119681. The repository holds the analysis code, the result tables and the figures of the Open Research Europe article. Third party datasets and benchmark items are not included.
